title: Why Truck Insurance Costs So Much in 2026 (And the $4,111 Surprise)
description:
Insuring one electric pickup costs more than four thousand dollars a year. A giant Ram thirty-five hundred heavy-duty truck can be cheaper to insure than a midsize Toyota Tacoma. And according to one major study, the average full-size pickup can actually cost less to insure than a sedan. Truck insurance in twenty twenty-six is full of surprises, and most buyers only discover them after they sign.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
